title: module-settings v1
description: One module's settings as a person overrides them: the file <HORDE_HOME>/settings/<module>.json, read by core/ModuleSettings.ps1 and written by a person, never by Horde. It holds only the settings that differ from the module's declared defaults; a missing file means every default. This schema is the file's ENVELOPE. What each setting may hold - its kind and its allowed range - is declared by the module in code (New-HordeModuleSettings) and checked there, because it differs per module and because the subset of draft-07 that core/Schema.ps1 implements has no maximum, no length and no way to refuse 1.0 where a whole number is asked for. A file that does not fit this envelope is not read at all: every finding is reported and every setting is its default.

settings.description: Setting name to value. Names are the module's declared names, lower camel case, compared exactly. A name the module did not declare, a value of the wrong kind and a value outside the allowed range are each reported by name, and that setting is its default.

x-horde-file.name: <module>.json, the module's declared name: lower-case letters, digits and hyphens
x-horde-file.encoding: UTF-8, with or without a byte-order mark; a text value may hold any character but a control character
x-horde-file.readers: core/ModuleSettings.ps1 (Get-HordeModuleSettings), which never creates the file or its folder
x-horde-file.writers: a person. Nothing in Horde writes it.
